p: Represents the layout configuration for application panels
(float) { get; set } = 25f: Gets or sets the width of panel buttons
(float) { get; set } = 250f: Gets or sets the width of the left panel
(float) { get; set } = 300f: Gets or sets the width of the right panel
(float) { get; set } = 200f: Gets or sets the height of the bottom panel
(bool) { get; set } = true: Gets or sets a value indicating whether the file explorer is visible
(bool) { get; set } = true: Gets or sets a value indicating whether the Git panel is visible
(bool) { get; set } = true: Gets or sets a value indicating whether the console is visible
